about: #113: the lost ducks at grade 4 at night: a duck of the flock and a lost duck carried to the pen with taps and presses (the lost duck stays in the hands on the long way), the count of the farmer by groups, and a wave after a short count.
allow: is under the bottom of the screen

tap.thingExpr: tre.activeVillage.state().entities.filter((e) => e.item?.kind === 'duck' && !e.item.stray && !e.item.held && e.item.zone !== 'event-duck-place' && !/-lost-/.test(e.item.zone ?? '')).sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.position.x - tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position.x, a.position.z - tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position.z) - Math.hypot(b.position.x - tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position.x, b.position.z - tre.activeVillage.state().entities.find((e) => e.id === 'hero').position.z))[0]?.id
